Public interface headers of [sql_mm](https://github.com/zer0k-z/sql_mm) (GPL-3.0) at commit 78e1e2c, the same
revision CS2KZ vendors. Only the headers are needed: sql_mm itself is a separate Metamod plugin that must be installed
on the server, and hns-movement finds it at runtime through `MetaFactory(SQLMM_INTERFACE)`.
